title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 3: Stardust Crusaders
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1987, delinquent teen Jotaro Kujo discovers he has a 'Stand', a spirit-like manifestation of fighting power. The vampire Dio, revived using Jonathan Joestar's body, is the cause, and his influence is slowly killing Jotaro's mother Holly. Jotaro, his grandfather Joseph and companions Avdol, Kakyoin, Polnareff and the dog Iggy travel from Japan to Egypt, fighting Dio's assassins on the way.
life_message: It holds up loyalty to friends and family and the courage to sacrifice for them.

content.note: Constant Stand battles with bloody wounds; Avdol, Iggy and Kakyoin die; Polnareff avenges his murdered sister (Wikipedia; CSM on the anime; abcb parent guide).
A parasitic flesh bud controlling minds, vampires, body horror and companions' deaths (Wikipedia; AniList Body Horror, Tragedy signals).
CSM cites an episode with a naked 12-year-old girl and a lustful orangutan played for comic menace (anime; to verify in manga); otherwise little.
Jotaro's rude speech; strong language rarer in early parts per CSM; abcb notes raw language in the OVA (to verify in manga).
Teen lead Jotaro smokes on panel (CSM; to verify frequency in manga).
Teen smoking and delinquent attitude shown as cool (CSM).
Large franchise with games and merchandise (CSM).
